title: AssetOpsBench: Benchmarking AI Agents for Task Automation in Industrial Asset Operations and Maintenance
abstract: arXiv:2506.03828v4 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: AI for Industrial Asset Lifecycle Management aims to automate complex operational workflows, such as condition monitoring and maintenance scheduling, to minimize system downtime. While traditional AI/ML approaches solve narrow tasks in isolation, Large Language Model (LLM) agents offer a next-generation opportunity for end-to-end automation. In this paper, we introduce AssetOpsBench, a unified framework for orchestrating and evaluating domain-specific agents for Industry 4.0. AssetOpsBench provides a multimodal ecosystem comprising a catalog of four domain-specific agents, a curated dataset of 140+ human-authored natural-language queries grounded in real industrial scenarios, and a simulated, CouchDB-backed IoT environment. translated_title: AssetOpsBench：面向工业资产运维任务自动化的AI智能体基准测试
translated_abstract: 工业资产生命周期管理中的人工智能旨在自动化复杂的操作工作流，例如状态监测和维护调度，以最大限度地减少系统停机时间。虽然传统的人工智能/机器学习方法只能孤立地解决狭窄的任务，但大型语言模型（LLM）智能体为实现端到端自动化提供了下一代机遇。在本文中，我们介绍了AssetOpsBench，这是一个用于编排和评估面向工业4.0的领域特定智能体的统一框架。AssetOpsBench提供了一个多模态生态系统，包括四个领域特定智能体的目录、一个包含140多个基于真实工业场景人工编写的自然语言查询的精选数据集，以及一个基于CouchDB的模拟物联网环境。我们引入了一个自动化评估框架，使用三个关键指标来分析“工具即智能体”（Tool-As-Agent）与“计划-执行器”两种范式之间的架构权衡，并提供了一个用于自动化的系统化流程……
tldr: 该论文提出了AssetOpsBench，一个用于编排和评估工业4.0领域特定AI智能体的统一框架，包含四个领域智能体目录、140多个基于真实工业场景的自然语言查询数据集和模拟物联网环境，并通过自动化评估框架比较了Tool-As-Agent与Plan-Executor两种架构范式的权衡。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces AssetOpsBench, a unified framework for orchestrating and evaluating domain-specific AI agents for Industry 4.0 asset operations, featuring a catalog of four domain agents, 140+ human-authored queries grounded in real industrial scenarios, and an automated evaluation framework analyzing trade-offs between Tool-As-Agent and Plan-Executor paradigms.
